summary: Code review PASS. All four example files correctly pass a unique kebab-case grid ID and shared JsonFileStorage instance to DataGrid::create(). The central storage bootstrap pattern is clean and idiomatic for example code. File path traversal is doubly guarded by validateGridID() in both JsonFileStorage and DataGrid::__construct(). The .gitignore correctly excludes runtime-generated JSON from version control. htmlspecialchars() on user-facing feedback output in example 3 is correct. No blocking issues found.

comments.note: examples/1-simple-grid.php and examples/2-bootstrap-grid.php still declare 'namespace AppUtils\Examples\Grids' while examples 3 and 4 do not. The Developer correctly removed this namespace from bootstrap.php noting it was never needed there — the same reasoning applies to examples 1 and 2, which are also standalone runnable scripts, not autoloaded classes. The namespace is harmless but creates an inconsistent style across the example set. Suggest removing in a future cleanup pass.

JsonFileStorageTest is missing edge-case tests for validateGridID() with invalid inputs (empty string, leading digit, leading hyphen, path separator characters). This was flagged by QA and is confirmed here. A dedicated test for this would document the security guard contract and prevent regression.

The two validateGridID() regexes differ in strictness: DataGrid::__construct() enforces strict lowercase kebab-case (/^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/) while JsonFileStorage::validateGridID() allows uppercase and underscores (/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9\-_]*$/). Both prevent path traversal, but the mismatch means JsonFileStorage can be used directly with IDs (e.g. 'Grid_1') that DataGrid::create() rejects. Pre-existing scope from WP-001/WP-003, not introduced here. Worth normalizing in a future pass.
